notes: LIKEs si.SearchDetails only. ORDER BY StockItemName. SearchDetails is NOT NULL for every item, so the match is purely on the needle.

cases.name: usb-three
cases.why: 'USB' is in the SearchDetails of items 1,2,5 -> three rows ordered by name (food warmer, missile, rocket).

cases.name: gadget-detail-match
cases.why: 'gadget' is in items 1,2 SearchDetails (not item 5) -> two rows. Distinguishes SearchDetails matching from Tags matching (the ...ByTags proc).

cases.name: top-2-pagination
cases.why: 'USB' matches three but TOP(2) truncates to the first two by name (food warmer, missile). Pagination boundary.
